gaps.explanation: The printed report itself does not add up (already in report_discrepancies). Revised Exhibit A (trimmed p1), line 16 'Local Receipts: Local Option Sales Tax': General Fund cell printed 3,475.84, but the TOTAL column prints 8,475.84 and the General Fund line 21 Total Receipts prints 31,191.98, which requires 8,475.84 (10,671.97 + 357.68 + 3,475.84 + 1,089.70 + 10,596.79 = 26,191.98, i.e. 5,000.00 short of 31,191.98). The JSON statement receipt uses the printed Total-column 8,475.84 (statement total 48,348.19 = printed General 31,191.98 + Street 17,156.21); the detail line (index 2, General Fund, 3,475.84) keeps the printed fund cell. Gap 5,000.00 = 8,475.84 - 3,475.84 exactly. Both figures are printed; no line is missing or duplicated, so no add/remove (changing the detail amount would alter a printed amount).
